description: A replay of the same idempotency key with deliberately different content yields IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT, blocks all mutations, names the differing fields, and requires human review.
why_it_exists: This is the case QA - Replay Write Test failed: with only appendOrUpdate, the second write silently replaced communication_id, subject, summary, classification and received_at on the stored row. The gate exists so a contradicting redelivery is refused and reported rather than applied.

payload.subject: Re: QA replay test SECOND DELIVERY
payload.summary: replay delivery with deliberately different content

expect.reason: Key MAT-QA-001|MSG-QA-1 already recorded with different content (communication_id, subject, summary, classification, received_at). Nothing was changed. Human review required.

assertions: Every differing compare field is listed, in the declared compare order, in conflict_fields and in the reason text.
allow_mutations is false, so Communications, Actions and Matters are untouched.
requires_human_review is true and severity is WARNING.
Comparison is on string-coerced values with null/undefined treated as the empty string.
